dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with Dialog System (DSRUN) for GUI screens; uses COMP-X, COMP-5, object references (OO extensions), and Micro Focus-style COPY with quoted filenames and .CPB/.CPY/.MF extensions

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian accounts payable / check (cheque) issuance system; handles both sight (à vista) and post-dated (pré-datado) checks, updating a check register (talão de cheques)
purpose.summary: CBP105 is a check-issuance program that allows users to emit sight or post-dated checks. It validates the check number against a check register (CBD100), reads bank and supplier/payee data, optionally prints the check via CBP200, and records the check with its status (2=sight, 3=post-dated). It integrates with accounts-payable data (CPD020, currently commented out).

notable_features: Micro Focus Dialog System (DSRUN) GUI framework
Large commented-out block for accounts-payable list-box population
CANCEL after each subprogram CALL (dynamic loading)
Brazilian Portuguese comments and variable names
Date handling via GRIDAT1/GRIDAT2 utility calls
class-control paragraph defining Window OO class
verdict.notes: Program authored by Mareli Amancio Volpato, dated 30/10/1998. Brazilian Portuguese throughout. The program_type is effectively an online/GUI batch program driven by Micro Focus Dialog System rather than CICS; 'online-cics' is the closest enum but it is actually a Dialog System GUI app. Several sections related to accounts-payable verification are commented out, suggesting the feature was deferred or removed.
